about: The pinned toolchains and libraries (Windows, and the Linux release folder's), fetched by tools/release/fetch_toolchain.py into work/toolchain-cache/<name>/ (download, SHA-256 check, unpack). 'host' says where an entry is used: linux = the cross build on Linux (tools/build-win.sh), windows = the Windows-hosted build the installer will bundle, any = both, native = the Linux build with a pinned toolchain (the Linux release folder; KZ_LINUX_TOOLCHAIN=pinned in a clone). '{version}' in a url is the entry's own version. sha256 TO-FILL = never fetched: fetch_toolchain.py refuses it unless --fill, which records the hash of the first download (check it against the release page's published hash where there is one). pin TO-CONFIRM = the version was chosen without looking at the release page: confirm it there, then --fill. After Project Pyrrhus's and Project Helghast's tools/release/toolchain.json (undecuple, MIT): the same llvm-mingw, CMake, Ninja and Python pins.

build_tools.name: innosetup
build_tools.about: Build-time only, never shipped: the official Inno Setup installer that tools/release/build_setup.py installs (hash-checked) to compile installer/vekta.iss. Hash: Project Pyrrhus's and Project Helghast's pin.

components.name: llvm-mingw-linux
components.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (clang, lld, compiler-rt, libc++, libunwind); MinGW-w64 headers and CRT: ZPL-2.1 and public-domain parts; winpthreads: MIT and BSD-3-Clause; llvm-mingw scripts: ISC
components.about: The C/C++ compiler of the cross build on Linux: the same llvm-mingw release as the Windows-hosted one below, so both routes compile with one compiler. Build-time only; the exe links libc++, libunwind and winpthreads statically.

components.name: llvm-mingw
components.about: The Windows-hosted compiler the installer will bundle. Hash from Project Pyrrhus's toolchain.json (the same zip).

components.name: cmake

components.name: ninja
components.about: Ninja for the Windows-hosted build. Hash: the same as Project Pyrrhus's pin (checked by download, 2026-10-31).

components.name: python
components.about: The embeddable Python that runs ps3recomp's lifters on Windows. Hash from Project Pyrrhus's toolchain.json.

components.name: sdl2
components.about: SDL2 for MinGW (headers, import library, SDL2.dll): the window, input and sound. SDL2.dll goes beside the exe.

components.name: zlib
components.about: zlib, built from source with llvm-mingw by tools/release/build_win_deps.py and linked statically. Hash: the one zlib.net publishes for zlib-1.3.1.tar.gz.

components.name: glslang
components.license: BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, MIT, Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt lists each file's terms)
components.about: glslang, built from source with llvm-mingw (its C++ API must be compiled with the same libc++ as the exe) and linked statically: the guest shaders' GLSL to SPIR-V at run time. 16.6.0 is the glslang of Vulkan SDK 1.4.363.0 (tag vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0, same commit).

components.name: vulkan-headers
components.about: Vulkan's headers (headers only: vulkan-1.dll comes with the GPU driver). 1.4.363: the headers of the same SDK as the glslang pin.

components.name: ffmpeg
components.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (the lgpl-shared build: headers and DLLs; its source is named in the build's own files)
components.about: FFmpeg 9 for Windows, BtbN's lgpl-shared build of autobuild-2026-10-27-18-38: the headers the movie player's run-time loader compiles against, and the DLLs it loads beside the exe (avcodec-63, avformat-63, avutil-61, swresample-7, swscale-10; without them the movies are skipped). The maintainer's tested build, byte for byte. BtbN removes most dated builds after a while (keeping the month's last): when this url stops working, move the pin to a kept build and fill its hash again.

components.name: zig
components.license: MIT (Zig); its bundled clang/LLVM, libc++, libc++abi and libunwind: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; glibc's headers and stub libraries: LGPL-2.1-or-later; the other libcs' headers under their own terms (the package's lib/ folder)
components.about: The Linux build's C and C++ compiler: zig cc / zig c++ (clang with glibc's headers and libc++ inside, PyPI's ziglang wheel, a zip), driven by tools/release/zig/ for the target x86_64-linux-gnu.2.31, so the port builds with nothing from the system and runs on any glibc 2.31 or newer. Build-time only; libc++ is linked statically.

components.name: cmake-linux
components.about: CMake for the Linux build with the pinned toolchain (the same version as the Windows one). Hash: by download, 2026-11-02.

components.name: ninja-linux
components.about: Ninja for the Linux build with the pinned toolchain. Hash: by download, 2026-11-02.

components.name: sdl2-src
components.about: SDL2's source, the same version as the Windows package: built by build_linux_deps.py only to link against (headers and libSDL2-2.0.so); the game uses the system's libSDL2-2.0.so.0 at run time, which every desktop with games has, so the window, sound and input follow the system's X11, Wayland and audio. Hash: by download, 2026-11-02.

components.name: ffmpeg-linux
components.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (the lgpl-shared build: headers and shared libraries; its source is named in the build's own files)
components.about: FFmpeg 9 for Linux, the same BtbN autobuild as the Windows pin: the headers the movie loader compiles against and the shared libraries it loads from beside the program (libavcodec.so.63 and the rest), so the movies play whatever FFmpeg the system has. Hash: by download, 2026-11-02. When BtbN removes the dated build, move both FFmpeg pins together.

file_sets.name: dlss-sdk
file_sets.license: NVIDIA RTX SDKs License (LICENSE.txt of the SDK): proprietary, not redistributable here
file_sets.about: The NVIDIA DLSS SDK files the DLSS path compiles and links against, and the DLSS runtime library that goes beside the program: fetched on the player's machine only, by tools/release/firstrun.py's dlss step after the player accepted NVIDIA's licence (tools/release/fetch_toolchain.py --set dlss-sdk --accept-license), into work/toolchain-cache/dlss-sdk/ laid out as the SDK folder. Never in this repository or a release asset (tools/release/assemble_payload.py refuses any NVIDIA file). Only the files for the build's OS (os) are fetched; the Windows ones are pinned for when the Windows build has DLSS. Headers: the ones rsx_vk_dlss.cpp includes, and what they include. Hashes checked against the v310.9.16 tag's files (2026-11-05).
